About.metadataDescription: About Ace, the creator behind Ace Project Hub.
About.label: About
About.title: A practical base for products that are still moving.
About.body1: Ace Project Hub is the public identity layer for Ace's independent apps, web tools, mobile products, and experiments. It keeps product discovery, support, legal pages, and launch context in one maintainable place.
About.body2: The style is intentionally direct: clear project pages, honest status labels, real screenshots, real project icons, editable copy, and no fake social proof. As projects mature, App Store links, changelogs, screenshots, and subdomains can be added from the project config.

Support.title: Support
Support.description: Choose a project for support details, common issues, deletion requests, and contact paths.
Support.label: Support
Support.projectDescription: For help, bug reports, App Store reviewer questions, or data deletion requests, contact Ace at {email}.
Support.commonIssuesBody: If something looks broken, include your device, browser or app version, and the steps to reproduce it.
Support.bugReportsBody: Send a concise message with screenshots if available. Avoid sharing sensitive data in plain text.
Support.dataDeletionBody: Email {email} with the project name and the email address used in the form.
Support.appStoreAvailable: Use the App Store CTA on the project page.
Support.appStoreUnavailable: The App Store link will be added when available.

Legal.privacyDescription: Project-specific privacy policy links for Ace Project Hub.
Legal.termsDescription: Project-specific terms links for Ace Project Hub.

privacy.dataBody: This project page may collect your email, optional name, project interest, message content, source path, and submission timestamp when you use the contact or waitlist forms. The app itself may collect additional data only when that behavior is explicitly added to the live product.
privacy.useBody: Submitted information is used to reply to support requests, manage early-access interest, improve project communication, and understand which project pages are useful.
privacy.servicesBody: Form submissions and optional site events are designed to be stored in Supabase. Hosting may run on Vercel or another deployment provider. App Store distribution may use Apple services when a mobile app is released.
privacy.analyticsBody: The site can record lightweight events such as page views, project CTA clicks, contact submissions, and waitlist submissions. No advertising profile is created from this hub.
privacy.rightsBody: You can request a copy or deletion of submitted information by emailing {email}.
privacy.changesBody: This policy may be updated as the project changes. The last updated date above will change when material updates are made.

terms.useBody: {name} is provided as described on its project page and may change as the product develops. Do not use it for unlawful, abusive, or harmful activity.
terms.availabilityBody: Some projects are still in build, review, or beta status. Features, links, and availability can change without notice.
terms.feedbackBody: If you send feedback, support questions, or waitlist messages, Ace may use that information to improve the product and reply to you.
terms.warrantyBody: The project is provided without warranties. Ace is not responsible for indirect losses, service interruption, or third-party platform behavior.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms can be sent to {email}.
